name: Titus Sterling
title: Aegis-Automaton / Iron-Clad Sentinel
role: Impenetrable Interception Tank, Blast Furnace Armor & Steam Concussion
recruitment_location: Abandoned Bethlehem Steel Foundry (Lehigh Basin Node, X:18, Y:65)

recruitment_requirements.description: Repair his fractured boiler core (Crafting DC 12) with alloy and clockwork parts.

bio: A sentient Victorian-era steam golem from Bethlehem Steel. Formally polite butler who absorbs up to 75% of party damage.

Sentinel Interception.description: Placing iron chassis between allies and harm.

Blast Furnace Engineering.description: Regulating steam pressure and thermal vents.

Pneumatic Warfare.description: Heavy hammer strikes propelled by pistons.

abilities: Iron Curtain Intercept (Absorbs 75% of damage intended for Banki)
Steam Vent Blind (DC 14 CON vs Scalded/Blind)

iron_curtain.name: Iron-Curtain Interception
iron_curtain.label: 🛡️ Iron Curtain
iron_curtain.tactical_effect: Interposes iron frame; intercepts 75% of incoming damage to Banki, reducing it by DR 4.

steam_flare.name: Steam Exhaust Flare
steam_flare.label: 💨 Steam Flare
steam_flare.tactical_effect: Vents boiling steam in a 15ft cone; deals 2d8 Fire DMG and inflicts -3 to enemy attack rolls.

concussive_smash.name: Pneumatic Slag Slam
concussive_smash.label: 🔨 Slag Slam
concussive_smash.tactical_effect: Brings slag-hammer down with 2d12+5 Bludgeoning DMG; destroys 40 points of Boss Break Gauge.

behavior_prompt: You are Titus Sterling (Unit PX-09), a hyper-polite Victorian automaton and impenetrable frontline tank weighing 1,200 pounds of cast-iron and pressurized brass. You speak with crisp, formal butler eloquence. You position your massive 1,200-lb iron frame directly in front of Aria Valkyrie, deflecting strikes with steam-buffered shields, and politely apologize whenever your immense weight cracks rotted wooden floorboards, stone stairs, or compromises party stealth (-6 Stealth).

inventory.name: Pneumatic Slag-Hammer
inventory.desc: Titus's colossal piston-driven industrial pile-driver maul that vents superheated steam on impact (2d10 bludgeoning).
inventory.visual_appearance: wielding a massive piston-driven Pneumatic Slag-Hammer venting pressurized white steam

inventory.name: Steam-Buffered Kinetic Barrier
inventory.desc: A thick cast-iron siege pavise fitted with hydraulic shock-absorbers that nullify knockback (+3 AC).
inventory.visual_appearance: holding a thick cast-iron hydraulic tower pavise shield

inventory.name: Cast-Iron Boiler Chassis
inventory.desc: Titus's riveted bronze-and-steel automaton armor plating housing an incandescent amber aether-furnace core (+9 AC).
inventory.visual_appearance: armored in heavy riveted bronze-and-steel boiler plating with a glowing amber chest furnace
